import json, sys, numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work'); sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submission')
import gen as G, check as C
import planner as P
n=int(sys.argv[1]); seed0=int(sys.argv[2])
worst=[]
for i in range(n):
    r=G.gen(seed0+i)
    L=C.build(r)
    try:
        req=P.parse_request(json.dumps(r).encode())
        prob=P.Problem(req)
        sol=P.solve_optimal(prob)
        if sol is None:
            y,q=P.solve_infeasible(prob)
            m=max(np.max(np.abs(y)), np.max(np.abs(q)))
            worst.append((m, seed0+i))
    except Exception as e:
        print("err", seed0+i, repr(e))
worst.sort(reverse=True)
print(worst[:10])
PYEOF
